result.summary: Found 1 issue: the bottom navigation highlights Profile as active while the screen shows the home discovery feed.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar shows 'Profile' as the selected tab (green icon and bold green label), but the content displayed is the home/browse screen: delivery address, search bar, category filters, promo banner, and restaurant listings. The active tab state does not match the visible page.
issues.suggestion: Apply the active/green state to the tab that matches the current screen (Home) and only highlight Profile when profile content is actually shown, so navigation state stays consistent with the page content.
